_doc: EP1 MASTER OVERLAY v2 (g1..g8). Every track names its segment ('seg' = g1..g8) and uses that segment's OWN seconds (t0/t1, run, note_t); 'gt0'/'gt1' (and 'gt_in') are the same times in master seconds (segment start + local, starts from aot/segtime.py, total 421.9). The 'segments' table lists id, start, dur. A track with 'alive': 'march846' follows march846.alive(t - alive_t_offset) (march846 starts at g3 31.3). '_remap' says how a track was placed; event-anchored ones were re-timed to the new beats, not mapped one-to-one. 'unmapped' holds the v1 tracks that no longer map cleanly (NOT rendered). g4/g5/g6 name tags (EREN, MIKASA) live in graphics_timelines/g*_tags.json and are burnt into those segments' previews: do not duplicate them here. The original is master_overlay.v1.json. Fonts as in v1 (New Rocker captions/title, Russo One tags, Share Tech else).
